Living + @hash URLs

Publish with tot. The living URL tracks the branch tip; the @hash URL freezes this exact commit so a link in a review or comment never rots. Paste both into the PR description.

tot: tot/<owner>/<repo>/<slug> (living — branch tip)
tot: tot/<owner>/<repo>/<slug>#@<sha> (@hash — frozen)
Security: if the writeup contains anything sensitive, share the file path instead of a tot link ("link is the key" is for non-sensitive artifacts only).

Canonical source

The markdown source of record for this writeup lives at docs/plans/...[slug]-pr-writeup.md (see the <meta name="source"> header of this file). Edit the .md; regenerate this render. Drift between this page and the source is a bug.
